about: A Rust library for reading, changing and writing PDF files.

prs.title: New PDFs no longer use the object number other readers ignore
prs.broken: PDFs built with the library gave their first object number 0, which the PDF format reserves. Other readers treated it as missing, so an image could vanish or a page render blank.
prs.changed: I made a new file keep number 0 reserved, so the first real object gets number 1.
prs.matters: PDFs the library writes open correctly in other viewers.
